mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (post_id, member_id, rating, content) VALUES (#{dto.postId}, #{memberId}, #{dto.rating}, #{dto.content})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.post_id AS postId, r.member_id AS memberId, m.nickName AS memberNickName, m.image AS memberImage, r.rating, r.content, COUNT(rl.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM review_likes WHERE review_id = r.id AND member_id = #{memberId}) AS liked, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM reviews r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN review_likes rl ON r.id = rl.review_id WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} GROUP BY r.id, r.post_id, r.member_id, m.nickName, m.image, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.post_id AS postId, r.member_id AS memberId, m.nickName AS memberNickName, m.image AS memberImage, r.rating, r.content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_likes WHERE review_id = r.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM review_likes WHERE review_id = r.id AND member_id = #{memberId}) AS liked, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM reviews r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT image_url FROM review_images WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO review_likes (review_id, member_id) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{memberId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM review_likes WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET rating = COALESCE((SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews WHERE post_id = #{postId}), 0), review_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE post_id = #{postId}) WHERE post_id = #{postId}
